proportionality.meaning: Change in log(source/reference ratio) per unit log(paired detections). Non-zero means the ratio depends on fire size/activity, so a constant-ratio conversion is biased at extremes.

drift.meaning: Trend of the log ratio across the overlap. A significant trend means transferring the calibration outside the overlap period is unsafe.

zero_check.meaning: If observed zeros greatly exceed the NB-expected share, there is zero inflation beyond overdispersion.

warnings: Some harmonised weeks are converted outside the calibration overlap (temporal transfer); this assumes the sensor ratio is stationary.
harmonization.target: Aqua-equivalent quality-filtered detections per week at nominal reference looks (coverage-adjusted)
